description: Link Portal can never succeed (mapped patients defect #1, confirmed). The dialog sends only {"email":"john.doe@patient.test"} to POST /api/patients/patient-seed-1/link-user, and the backend answers 400 "email, password, firstName, and lastName are required to create a new user". The dialog has no fields for those.
expected: The dialog collects what the API needs (or the API derives names from the patient and issues an invite), and linking succeeds.
actual: Destructive toast with the raw backend message; dialog stays open; no path forward.
suggested_fix: Either add password/first/last fields (prefilled from patient.name) or make the backend create the user with an invite or reset code when only an email is given.

description: The linked state is invisible (mapped patients defect #2, confirmed). After linking Rohit Agarwal through the API, GET /patients omits portalUserId (keys returned have no portalUserId; GET /patients/:id has it). The row still shows "Link Portal", and clicking Link gives 409 "Patient is already linked to a user". The "Portal Linked" badge and Unlink are therefore unreachable.
actual: Every row shows Link Portal; linking an already-linked patient ends in a 409 toast.
suggested_fix: Add portalUserId to the list select in patients.service.ts.

description: The failure toast shows the raw validation sentence with a request UUID ("…required to create a new user (Reference: c2bf49e0-…)") and covers the header bell and user menu at top right.
expected: Human copy that tells the admin what to do; the toast does not hide header controls.

description: Every dialog open logs "Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for {DialogContent}". Nothing in the dialog explains that a PATIENT login will be created or how the patient gets a password.
expected: A DialogDescription explaining what linking does.
actual: No description; screen readers get only the title.
